text:
evan-csm: Quick weekly pulse for Bellwether Health — new rollout to rwd-3b-v2 happened Monday. Can we summarize adoption, fallback behaviour, and renewal risk?

maria-ops: 7-day adoption 62% (was ~21% before canary). Traffic split currently ~70% rwd-3b-v2 / 30% legacy. Noted increase in fallbacks for long sequences.

june-analytics: Usage +18% w/w (1.9M -> 2.25M tokens/day). Spend +12% last 7d. Latency p50=120ms, p95=430ms (p95 jumped during Tue spike). Error rate baseline 0.6% -> spike to 2.9% at Tue 11:34 UTC. Fallback rate baseline 4.1% -> peak 9.8% at same timestamp.

sam-eng: Root cause looks like `KVCacheMissError` on quantized path when seq_len > 1024. Repro in staging with long prompts. Adding guard and fallback avoidance patch.

lara-cs: Customer reported a handful of "generation cutoff" cases affecting high-value workflows. They're worried ahead of renewal (next Fri). Marking renewal risk as elevated until we show trend improvement.

evan-csm: Suggested mitigation: temporary routing rule for long sequences -> legacy, enable prefix caching for top routes, and proactive enablement call + credits if needed. Goal: fallback <2% before renewal.

maria-ops: Action items: (1) sam to open PR w/ fix and ETA EOD, (2) ops to implement routing rule by tomorrow 09:00 PDT: `if seq_len > 1024 -> route legacy`, (3) CSM to schedule enablement call with Bellwether tomorrow 15:00 PST.

sam-eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4512 — unit tests green. Will canary deploy after CI. Quick snippet of fix: ```python
if seq_len > 1024:
    route = 'legacy'
else:
    route = preferred_model
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for infra/kv-fix (PR 4512) at 2026-03-20T18:01:12Z. Targets: canary-dedicated-3 hosts. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.dev/canaries/4512

june-analytics: I'll attach updated charts to the renewal pack: fallback-trend (7d), latency distribution, spend delta. Will also run an AB test metric for generation completeness on a 5k-sample prompt set.

lara-cs: I'll draft a customer note offering 2 weeks of reduced fees and a dedicated troubleshooting call. If canary fixes the issue, we can move to normal routing and highlight improvements in renewal brief. :pray:

evan-csm: Thanks team. Please reply here when canary shows sustained fallback <1% for 24h and p95 <300ms — that's our signal to de-escalate the renewal risk.

(Notes: kept thread compact for exec summary; full dashboards and logs are in the shared drive.)
